title: The Archive Ghost | ECHO//100 Episode 92
description:
Kavi discovers that Mira has been repurposed as the living architecture of his unstable reality. He must stabilize her core before the environment collapses entirely. Episode 92 of ECHO//100: ARC. This content is original fiction assisted by AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The bedroom walls bleed flickering blue text, forming Mira’s silhouette against the decaying, gravity-defying wallpaper.
scenes.caption: Mira's digital ghost
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses standing in a floating bedroom, looking at walls covered in shimmering blue holographic text forming a female shape.

scenes.text: Byte’s rusted shell leaks raw data, creating a bridge between Kavi and the shifting foundation.
scenes.caption: Byte's data leak
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching toward a rusted, ancient white robot with a cyan face, while glowing blue data drips from its joints onto the floor.

scenes.text: Kavi touches the wall, realizing Mira isn't trapped—she is the very operating system of this world.
scenes.caption: Mira is the architecture
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's hand pressing against a wall that looks like a complex digital circuit board made of blue light.

scenes.text: He attempts to patch her fractured logic, but the room groans as the floor tiles dissolve.
scenes.caption: Repairing the core
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holding a glowing handheld device toward the wall, while the room around him begins to pixelate and break apart.

scenes.text: Mira’s voice echoes through the foundation, warning that her integration is the only thing holding reality.
scenes.caption: The warning echoes
scenes.image_prompt: Mira's holographic teal coat shimmering as she appears partially, her eyes glowing with raw, unformatted system data.

scenes.text: Stabilizing her core shifts the anchor, exposing a dark, corrupted sector hidden beneath the perfect timeline.
scenes.caption: The hidden sector
scenes.image_prompt: The floor beneath Kavi turning transparent, revealing a terrifying, dark, and glitched-out void underneath the bedroom.

scenes.text: The corruption spreads, forcing Kavi to choose between saving Mira or sealing the gateway forever.
scenes.caption: A critical choice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking down at his backpack, his expression panicked as the room begins to tilt violently toward the dark void.

scenes.text: A message from Null manifests in the air, written in the font of the dead phone.
scenes.caption: Null's arrival
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring in horror as dark, purple-black glitched text with sharp red eyes appears floating in the center of the crumbling room.
